First time here, dont know how i have lived in SA my whole life and I had never been here. They got a little bit of everything. Think feed store meets, bodega meets, boutique. I went here because I can never find straw and I have to drive to Tractor Supply to get a bale. They are the first place that I have been able to find it at. I bought some feed since I was there and a couple of random items. The spanish speaking woman who answered my questions about the feed, was very nice. The two men that loaded my stuff also very nice. As I walked around looking at all the stuff they had (cause i like to shop) I got a few looks, people walking by to see what i was doing. I get it, that's your business and you have yo look out for your merchandise, but it was to an uncomfortable amount. Then there was the young woman at the register, in my opinion either she is over her job or just doesn't care.  Her standoffish attitude was disappointing. I don't expect people to go out of their way for me, but I can definetly go without the attitude. Maybe she was just annoyed that I had to keep asking her to repeat herself, because she spoke very softly and i literally could not hear what she was telling me, either way it just had such a negative affect on my experience there that i felt I had too mention it.
However if you have never been, go check it out and decide for yourself.
